title: Great tour but confirm the meeting point ahead.
text: Our tour got off to a rocky start because of a conflict of the meeting point. But once we found the proper location and met our guide Victor we had a wonderful tour. He was very informative, easy to hear, and moved at a good pace for everyone in the group.
author: Lisa_R

title: Great Paella and Sangria from scratch
text: Great experience. We learn how to do a proper paella and sangrias from scratch. I had a lot of fun and learn so much. I recommend it.
author: alejandrocY6197NV

title: Great tour every other aspect a mess
text: Impossible to find the starting point, no taxi knows how to get there and if you’re 5 minutes late you miss your tour. They also changed the time to an hour later so we had to rearrange our day which was quite a burden and it being in Europe there was zero customer service or apologies. Roberto our guide was spectacular once we got to the park. Go at your own risk
author: Vincente_G

title: Overpriced
text: Check carefully about pricing. I paid $119 for 2  persons , website cost is only $35 per person. I will check with Viator
author: Ceazonia_D
